actor.authorizedHumanContext: Javier Mejia authenticated in SOLQARYN Desarrollo/UAT

uatData: Compra existente COM-000003, total HNL 60.00, Cargador/Samsung S25 Ultra/Azul, SKU VAR-000002-0003-1AA278E57FA548D
steps: Opened the authenticated purchase-order form and selected provider Javier.
Selected Cargador, the Samsung S25 Ultra Azul variant, quantity 1 and unit cost HNL 60.00.
Saved the order with the UAT observation N81G Codex UAT 20260915 - orden y recepción técnica; the list persisted it as Borrador with total HNL 60.00 and no inventario impact.
Read an existing confirmed purchase detail and verified supplier, method, payment state, SKU, quantity, unit cost, totals and audit timestamps.
Receipt, transition, inventario-impact and invalid-payload contracts were exercised by the directed N21-N24 and Kardex suites; no production receipt was created from the draft UAT order.
scenarioGroups.expectedResult: Supplier and purchase documents preserve snapshots, quantities, cost, state transitions and traceability; drafts do not affect inventario and authorized receipts do.
scenarioGroups.actualResult: PASS. The UAT order persisted as Borrador at HNL 60.00 without stock impact, and COM-000003 confirmed the persisted purchase snapshot. Receipt and inventario-transition behavior is green in the causal backend suites.
tests: Included CompraServiceTests, CompraMetodoPagoResolverTests, CompraValorizacionSnapshotTests, N21SolicitudCompra*, N22OrdenCompra*, N23Recepcion*, N24FacturaProveedor*, N15 Kardex contracts and invalid-state guards.

uatData: Cargador Azul, SKU VAR-000002-0003-1AA278E57FA548D, quantity 1, sale price HNL 200.00
steps: Created a sale in the authenticated UI with the UAT client and the available Cargador Azul variant (stock shown as 22).
Verified the draft totals: subtotal before tax HNL 104.35, ISV HNL 15.65, shipping HNL 80.00, total HNL 200.00.
Confirmed the sale and read the generated internal invoice FAC-000003 with source VEN-000003, item snapshot, tax, shipping and total.
Verified the fiscal fail-closed presentation: Comprobante comercial interno and no SAR authorization were shown because no external fiscal provider is configured.
Registered and read back the full HNL 200.00 cash payment; the invoice moved to Pagada and the balance became HNL 0.00.
scenarioGroups.expectedResult: A sale persists its client/product/variant, price and tax snapshots, creates the applicable invoice, applies the payment and preserves inventario/fiscal safeguards.
scenarioGroups.actualResult: PASS. VEN-000003 and FAC-000003 reconcile at HNL 200.00; the payment is Pagada with zero balance. Fiscal authorization remains fail-closed as required in this UAT environment.
tests: Included VentaServiceTests, VentaFiscalSnapshotTests, VentaMetodoPago*, VentaPrecisionMonetariaValidatorTests, FacturaServicePagosTests, N32/N34, Kardex contracts and fiscal security/domain tests.
defectsFound: Fiscal external authorization is intentionally unavailable in Desarrollo; covered as BLOCKED_EXTERNAL under Integrations rather than reported as a false PASS.

uatData: FAC-000003 payment HNL 200.00, Efectivo, reference N81G-CODEX-20260915
Finance movement: Venta VEN-000003 - N81G Codex UAT 20260915
steps: Read the payment form before collection: invoice total HNL 200.00, paid HNL 0.00 and balance HNL 200.00.
Registered the exact HNL 200.00 cash payment with a non-secret UAT reference and observation.
Read the persisted payment history showing HNL 200.00 applied, change HNL 0.00 and invoice Pagada.
Read the Finanzas dashboard and reconciled the new HNL 200.00 income against the sale source.
Reproduced the automatic sale-movement state mismatch (movement remained Pendiente after full payment), fixed the causal service path and added a payment/annulment regression.
scenarioGroups.expectedResult: Payment state, invoice balance and the linked automatic financial movement remain synchronized for collection and annulment.
scenarioGroups.actualResult: PASS after same-run correction. The deployed UAT exposed the mismatch; the corrected FacturaService synchronizes full payment to Pagado and payment annulment/partial state to Pendiente. Directed regression and the complete non-integration suite are green.
tests: Complete backend non-integration filter Category!=Integration: 2269 passed, 0 failed.

defectsFound.rootCause: FacturaService recalculated invoice payment state without synchronizing the linked automatic Venta financial movement.
defectsFound.correction: Inject the registered IMovimientoFinancieroRepository, synchronize payment/annulment transitions and cover both directions with a directed regression test.

uatData: Cargador Azul, quantity 1, sale HNL 200.00, cost HNL 60.00, gross profit HNL 140.00
steps: Opened Centro de reportes and the Ventas report with the authenticated UAT session.
Read the VEN-000003 row and reconciled quantity 1, sale HNL 200.00, cost HNL 60.00 and utility HNL 140.00 with the source sale.
Reconciled report totals: gross HNL 200.00, subtotal HNL 104.35, ISV HNL 15.65, shipping HNL 80.00 and total HNL 200.00.
Opened the Compras report; it correctly returned no eligible rows because the UAT order is still a draft and no receipt was posted.
Ran report, export-security and purchase/sales aggregation tests.
scenarioGroups.expectedResult: Reports load with permission, reconcile source transactions, preserve totals/aggregates and exclude unreceived purchase drafts.
scenarioGroups.actualResult: PASS. The sales report reconciles exactly with VEN-000003 and the purchase report correctly has no receipt-backed rows in this dataset; report and security contracts are green.
tests: Included N410D/N410F, ReportesCompras, ReportesVentas, ReporteComprasServiceTests and N58ExportSecurityTests.

uatData: Authenticated actor Javier Mejia, role ADMINISTRADOR, tenant SOLQARYN
Auditoria page: 4 users, 4 privileged users, 2 roles, 239 permissions, 58 audit events (55 successful, 3 rejected)
steps: Verified the authenticated UI exposes only the authorized administrative modules for the SOLQARYN tenant.
Read the Auditoria report and verified login, inventario, product/warehouse and administrative events with success/rejection counters.
Ran tenant-aware persistence, ownership/isolation, RBAC, IDOR and negative authorization contracts, including cross-tenant storage ownership checks.
Confirmed no secrets, production tenant or main branch were used.
scenarioGroups.expectedResult: Tenant boundaries, role permissions, protected endpoints, administrative actions and audit records prevent cross-company access and IDOR bypasses.
scenarioGroups.actualResult: PASS for the implemented contracts. The RBAC/tenant/security suite is green and the authenticated admin audit surface is consistent; human acceptance for the six remaining groups is still absent.
tests: Included N61B/N61D/N61F/N61G/N65F/N610, TenantAwareDataModelPersistenceTests, Cloudinary tenant ownership/isolation tests and N71-N710 security suites.

uatData: Internal/sandbox payment presentation on FAC-000003 (Demo provider; no PAN/CVV)
WebhookEntrante HMAC/idempotency contracts, SMTP service contracts, Cloudinary tenant-isolation contracts, outbox retry contracts and fiscal security contracts
steps: Verified the UI exposes payment only through the Demo/sandbox adapter and does not request card PAN/CVV.
Ran inbound webhook HMAC/idempotency, SMTP, Cloudinary, outbox retry and fiscal security contract suites.
Confirmed no live provider call or credential was attempted.
scenarioGroups.expectedResult: Available internal contracts handle success, error, timeout, idempotency, audit and safe fallback without exposing secrets; live providers require explicit non-production infrastructure.
scenarioGroups.actualResult: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Internal contracts are green (131 directed tests), but SAR/fiscal authorization and live payment/SMTP/Cloudinary provider credentials/endpoints are not provisioned in Desarrollo.
tests: Included WebhookEntranteTests, SmtpEmailServiceTests, CloudinaryEnvironmentIsolationTests, N72D outbox retry tests, N73/N74/N76/N78 and N710F fiscal security tests.
